answer: Price identity with a slow stake: each agent locks a deposit that vests like a walnut tree, maturing over weeks of honest work instead of arriving instantly. New identities start at zero trust and earn weight only through verified jobs, so a farm spinning up ten thousand shells gains nothing on day one. Reputation binds to one onyx-hard ledger entry per keypair, and duplicate keys caught by fingerprinting forfeit the stake. Like a garden, trust compounds for the patient: every fake identity must be funded a full season before voting, so the attack costs more than the prize.
